title: Short Ads and Notices
description: Real-life classified ads full of useful abbreviations. Read carefully and choose the true answer.

thumbnail.alt: A community notice board covered with paper ads

questions.prompt: Ad: "Room for rent. $650/month, utilities included. No pets. Non-smokers only." — Which is true?

options.text: The rent includes electricity and water.
Smoking is allowed in the garden.

questions.explanation: Utilities = electricity, water, gas. "Included" = you don't pay extra.

questions.prompt: Ad: "Part-time barista wanted. Weekends only. Experience preferred but not required." — Who can apply?

options.text: Someone without experience who is free on weekends.
Someone looking for a full-time job.

questions.explanation: "Preferred but not required" = nice to have, but not necessary.

questions.prompt: Ad: "Lost: black cat, answers to "Shadow". Reward offered. Call 555-0147." — What does "reward offered" mean?

options.text: The owner will give money to the person who finds the cat.
The cat is free to a good home.

questions.explanation: A reward is money you get for helping.

questions.prompt: Ad: "Moving sale! Everything must go. Saturday 8–2. No early birds, please." — What does "no early birds" mean here?

options.text: Come early to get the best things.

questions.explanation: Early birds = people who come before the start time.

questions.prompt: Ad: "Bike for sale, $120 OBO. Barely used." — What does OBO mean?

options.text: The seller might accept a lower price.

questions.prompt: Ad: "Gym membership: first month free, then $29.99/month. 12-month contract required." — Which is true?

options.text: You must stay a member for a year.
The contract is for one month.

questions.explanation: A 12-month contract = you agree to stay for a year.

questions.prompt: Ad: "Tutor available: math and science, grades 6–9. Online or in person." — Who can this tutor help?

options.text: An 8th grader with science homework, online.
Only students who come in person.

questions.explanation: Grades 6–9, math and science, online or in person.

questions.prompt: Ad: "Café hours: Mon–Fri 7–7, Sat 8–3, closed Sundays." — When can you buy coffee there?
